Klasse AutomataMessages

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.automata.localisation.AutomataMessages
public class AutomataMessages extends Object

Provides localized messages for error and information handling in the Automata system. This class manages resource bundle access for internationalized strings, centralizing all message retrieval operations.

Seit:
1.0.0

    • unknownStartState

      public static String unknownStartState(@NonNull Object startState)

      Creates a localized message for an unknown start state error.

      Parameter:
      startState - the invalid start state that was encountered
      Gibt zurück:
      a formatted error message indicating the unknown start state
      Löst aus:
      NullPointerException - if startState is null
